question_text: A social worker discovers that a 16-year-old girl was recruited by a syndicate to work as a domestic helper in another city under false promises of education, but is now being forced to work long hours without pay and is not allowed to leave. Which of the following laws primarily addresses this situation?

options.text: RA 9208, as amended by RA 10364, the Anti-Trafficking in Persons Act.
RA 7610, the Special Protection of Children Against Abuse, Exploitation and Discrimination Act.
RA 9262, the Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act.
